en: Solid gallium metal will melt into a liquid puddle if you hold it in your bare hand.
The Statue of Liberty is green because its copper surface underwent a chemical change called oxidation.
A mixture of cornstarch and water acts like a solid when you punch it but flows like a liquid when you pour it.
Unlike almost all other substances, solid water ice is less dense than liquid water, which is why it floats.
Solid carbon dioxide, known as dry ice, skips the liquid phase entirely and turns directly into a gas through sublimation.
Bending a glow stick mixes two chemicals that release energy as visible light without producing any heat.
Water is called the universal solvent because it dissolves more different substances than any other common liquid on Earth.
Spider silk is a natural protein material that is stronger than steel of the exact same thickness but much more flexible.
Boiling red cabbage produces a purple liquid that changes to pink or green when mixed with acidic or basic substances.
Synthetic aerogel is a solid material composed of up to 99 percent air, making it one of the lightest solids.
Milk is an emulsion, which is a specific type of mixture where tiny liquid fat droplets are suspended in water.
Liquid nitrogen is so extremely cold at minus 196 degrees Celsius that it instantly freezes flowers solid.
